method: Built-in image_gen reference reconstruction; deterministic line effects. Not original game asset extraction.

ships.note: Individual PNGs use corrected direction names; original lateen atlas broadside columns are reversed. Angles are illustrative, not exact 3D renders.

limitations: Terrain layout and bathymetry are decorative, not a geospatial dataset.
Hidden content and unseen ship headings were synthesized.
Generated frames differ from original pixels.
Sprite anchor values in atlas_regions.json are initial suggestions and may need engine-specific alignment.
